map.越冬蜂群糖浆配比计算 使用指南: Winter Bee Syrup Mix Calculator User Guide
map.越冬蜂群糖浆配比计算器按蜂群数量、每群补饲糖浆量、糖水重量比与白糖单价，计算所需: The calculator uses colony count, syrup volume per colony, sugar-to-water weight ratio and sugar price to compute sugar needed, water, total syrup weight, feeding days and cost, with reference mixes for common ratios to help beekeepers prepare supplies.
map.10 群、每群 6 L、糖水比 2:1：糖质量分数 66.7%，密度约 1.34: 10 colonies × 6 L each, 2:1 sugar-to-water ratio: sugar mass fraction 66.7%, density about 1.34 kg/L, total syrup 80.4 kg, sugar 53.6 kg, water 26.8 kg; at CNY 6/kg the cost is about CNY 322; at 0.4 L per colony per day the syrup lasts about 15 days, so feed in 3 portions of 2 L each.
map.不建议。红糖含杂质和矿物质，易引起消化不良；来源不明的蜂蜜可能带入病原。越冬补饲: Not recommended. Brown sugar contains impurities and minerals that can cause digestive issues, and honey from unknown sources may carry pathogens. Use clean white sugar and water for winter feeding.
map.填入白糖单价、每群每日消耗量与计划饲喂天数，点击“计算”。: Enter the sugar price, daily consumption per colony and planned feeding days, then click Calculate.
map.填写蜂群数量与每群计划补饲的糖浆体积；弱群可适当减少单群量，强群可增加。: Enter colony count and planned syrup volume per colony; reduce the amount for weak colonies and increase it for strong colonies.
map.弱群复壮：用 1:1 稀糖浆少量多次奖励饲喂，促进产卵与造脾。: Weak colony recovery: feed small amounts of 1:1 light syrup to stimulate egg laying and comb building.
map.按结果称糖、称水，分 2–3 次在晴暖午后饲喂；需要备料清单时导出 CSV。: Weigh sugar and water according to the result, then feed in 2–3 portions on warm sunny afternoons; export CSV for a supply list.
map.本工具纯前端运行，输入不上传服务器，结果为配料与成本估算。实际补饲量应结合群势、: This tool runs entirely in the browser and does not upload inputs; results are ingredient and cost estimates. Adjust feeding to colony strength, honey stores and local winter length. Do not feed brown sugar, honey or syrup with additives; keep syrup at 30–35 °C to avoid scalding and robbing.
map.糖水比按重量计，例如 2:1 表示 2 kg 白糖配 1 kg 水。糖质量分数: Sugar-to-water ratios are by weight; for example, 2:1 means 2 kg sugar to 1 kg water. Sugar mass fraction f = sugar ÷ (sugar + water). Syrup density rises with concentration; the tool estimates density from f, then total weight = total syrup volume × density. Sugar = total weight × f; water = total weight − sugar. Feeding days = volume per colony ÷ daily consumption per colony.
map.越冬备料：一次算出白糖、加水与成本，避免配料不足或买多受潮。: Winter preparation: calculate sugar, water and cost at once to avoid shortages or excess that can absorb moisture.
map.选择糖水重量比：标准越冬常用 2:1，弱群复壮可用 1:1，强群寒冷地区可到 2: Choose the sugar-to-water ratio by weight: 2:1 is standard for winter, 1:1 for weak colony recovery, and up to 2.5:1 for strong colonies in cold regions.
map.饲喂计划：按每日消耗量估算几天喂完，避开低温阴雨与盗蜂高发时段。: Feeding plan: estimate how many days the supply lasts at the daily consumption rate, avoiding cold rain and periods of high robbing risk.
map.越冬糖浆为什么常用 2:1？: Why is 2:1 commonly used for winter syrup?
map.2:1（糖:水，按重量）糖分高、水分少，蜜蜂酿制负担小，低温下不易发酵，是多数地: A 2:1 sugar-to-water ratio by weight has high sugar and low water, reducing the bees’ processing burden and limiting fermentation at low temperatures; it is the common winter concentration in most regions. Adjust to local climate and colony strength.
map.不是。超过约 2.5:1 时糖浆黏度高、冷却后易结晶，蜜蜂取食困难，还可能刺激盗: No. Above about 2.5:1 the syrup becomes viscous, may crystallize as it cools, is difficult for bees to take and can encourage robbing. In winter, do not exceed 2.5:1 and adjust for temperature.
